narrative.overview: StadiYums looks like the last two minutes of a close game: navy conviction, orange urgency, numbers you can read at arm's length in daylight. The UI is a scoreboard-first mobile tool, not a marketing site. Surfaces stay light because fans use this outdoors in direct sun. Depth comes from tonal blocks, not drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Light theme optimized for bright stadium glare
Flat elevation with borders and tints
Scoreboard density and chunky tap targets

rules.name: The Orange Clock Rule
rules.body: Orange appears on every screen where the user must act now. If orange is decorative, remove it.

rules.name: The Sunlight Rule
rules.body: Never place low-contrast gray text on cream for anything operational. Seat numbers, prices, and status must pass a squint test in direct sun.

rules.name: The Ticket Stub Rule
rules.body: Anything a runner or fan needs to act on is Space Mono, weight 700 where numeric.

rules.name: The Signage Rule
rules.body: Archivo Black is for headings only. Never use it for body paragraphs or form labels.

rules.name: The Flat Bowl Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flush. If you need hierarchy, change the background color or add a border. Do not add drop shadows to cards or menu items.

dos: Do keep the page background cream and cards white for sun readability.
Do use Space Mono for seats, prices, order IDs, ETAs, and status badges.
Do use orange only where the user must act or pay attention now.
Do size tap targets at 30px minimum.
Do keep transitions short (0.15s to 0.3s ease) on color and transform only.
Do show fan and runner flows with equal visual weight.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS landing patterns: purple gradients, hero metric blocks, identical icon-card feature grids, or modern startup chrome.
Don't clone fast-food delivery app UI (DoorDash/Uber Eats layouts, cart patterns, or typography).
Don't add drop shadows to cards, menu items, or buttons.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or decorative blur.
Don't use Archivo Black for body copy or form labels.
Don't add 4px colored left stripes on new cards or list items.
Don't rely on motion to communicate status.
